leadText:
(Japanese: グルー Gurū) is a minor character who appeared in Destiny Deoxys. He is the referee and announcer of Pokémon battles that are held in the Battle Tower in LaRousse City.

Gurū judged the match of and Tory against Rafe and Sid. He also explained the rules of a Tag Battle to the audience.
